world_model_delta: Every completed quest produces a QUEST_RECEIPT_V0. Fields: quest_id, quest_type, faction, turn_completed, reward_granted, wulmoji_surface, authority=false, sovereign=false, status=PROPOSED. QUEST_RECEIPT is CONQUESTLAND-local, different namespace from governance receipts.
validator_question: Does QUEST_RECEIPT_V0 share any schema fields that could contaminate GARDEN_EPOCH_RECEIPT_V0?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: MEDIUM — receipt vocabulary is shared with governance; disambiguate via CONQUESTLAND namespace
